title: Why Vinyl Is Beating CDs Again
hook: The format everyone buried years ago is now outselling the one that replaced it.
closing: Vinyl survived streaming by becoming a premium niche, not the mass market.
question: What record would you buy?

segments.say: Vinyl earned 1.2 billion dollars last year, more than CDs managed to sell at all.
Vinyl also outsold CDs in plain unit count, not just dollars.
Streaming still takes 84 percent of music revenue, leaving vinyl a small but growing niche.
